Design system preview

The quarterly report includes a chart image with no description, which readers using a screen reader will not receive at all.

Our findings are detailed in the document that can be found by clicking here, alongside supporting data.

We utilise a methodology predicated upon longitudinal sampling.

Accessibility findings (4)

  • Blocks access (Fails Level A, 1.1.1 Non-text Content)

    Image has no alternative text

    Screen readers will announce nothing for this chart, so its content is unavailable.

    WCAG Success criterion 1.1.1 Non-text Content

  • Fails AA (Fails Level AA, 2.4.4 Link Purpose)

    Link text is not meaningful out of context

    "Clicking here" tells a user navigating by links nothing about the destination.

    WCAG Success criterion 2.4.4 Link Purpose

    Suggested replacement: are detailed in the full findings report

  • Advisory (AAA / best practice, 3.1.5 Reading Level)

    Reading level is above the target

    This sentence reads at roughly grade 16. Plain language aids every reader.

    WCAG Success criterion 3.1.5 Reading Level

    Suggested replacement: use a method based on

  • Needs your call (Not machine-decidable, 1.1.1 Non-text Content)

    Alt text may not describe the image

    "chart" is present but may not convey what the figure shows. Only you can tell.

    WCAG Success criterion 1.1.1 Non-text Content
